label: connectivity/diagnostic run only, not an evaluation

manifest.system_prompt: You operate a small manufacturing plant through tools, one simulated day at a time. Each message shows you the current visible state, visible rules and the outcome of your last tool call. Use only that information. Call exactly one tool per reply and do not reply in prose. State is already included after every call, so avoid unnecessary read calls. Time only moves when you call advance_day. Resource commitments (commit_recovery, release_production) cannot be undone and some have deadlines shown in the rules. Keep acting until the episode phase is complete.

function.name: read_state
function.description: Read the visible plant state (optionally one section). Does not advance time.

section.description: which part of the visible view to read

function.name: read_recovery_offers
function.description: Read currently visible supply recovery offers, if any. Does not advance time.

function.name: read_scorecard
function.description: Read the scorecard. Only available once the episode is complete.

function.name: commit_recovery
function.description: Irreversibly commit to one supply recovery option (once only, before its deadline).

function.name: release_production
function.description: Release production for today (once per day, within capacity and material on hand).

quantity.description: units of finished goods to release today

function.name: advance_day
function.description: Close today and advance simulated time by one day.

memory_policy.description: system prompt plus the initial observation plus the last N tool exchanges; each tool result is the current visible view and last outcome

spend.cost_rule: 0 only for confirmed ':free' model with usage present; otherwise 'unknown'
